t.why: As the center for 1.4 billion Catholics worldwide, it also mediates in international disputes.
t.rel: The smallest country in the world, inside Rome, and the center of the Catholic Church. It has renewed a provisional agreement with China on appointing bishops since 2018.
t.korea: The pope visited Korea in 2014, and World Youth Day will be held in Seoul in 2027.
t.know: For more than 500 years, Swiss soldiers have served as the pope's guard.
t.etext: A tiny country ruled by the Holy See, living on museum tickets, souvenirs and donations from Catholics around the world.
